# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_docs.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `make docs-gen`. -->

One pipeline sits behind every command: raw OHLCV bars -> `FeatureEngineer` ->
triple-barrier labels (with label spans) -> models. There are no intermediate
stage directories; every command that reads data takes the raw bars (`-d`,
parquet or csv) and applies the same cleaning, resampling and feature code as
`MLFactory` and the deployed bundles.

`ml` below is shorthand for `python -m src.cli`. Results go to
`<output_dir>/<run_id>/`; the evaluation commands (`cv`, `walk-forward`,
`cpcv-pbo`) evaluate the chronological **train split only** (validation and
test stay untouched), scale per fold, and purge on every label's actual end
bar with the derived purge/embargo (`--purge-bars` / `--embargo-bars`
override).

```bash
# Train xgboost + lstm + patchtst on 5-minute bars, stack with soft voting, backtest
ml run -d data/raw/MES_1m.parquet --bar-timeframe 5min \
    -m xgboost,lstm,patchtst --build-ensemble --meta-learner voting_meta -h 5 --backtest

ml status experiments/<run_id>          # checkpoint progress
ml run --resume experiments/<run_id>    # continue after a crash
ml cpcv-pbo -d data/raw/MES_1m.parquet -m xgboost,lightgbm,random_forest
```

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`ml run`](#ml-run) | Run the full pipeline (features, labels, training, ensemble, deploy) |
| [`ml data`](#ml-data) | Compute features and labels to parquet (no training) |
| [`ml status`](#ml-status) | Show checkpoint progress of a run |
| [`ml models`](#ml-models) | List registered models or show one model's configuration |
| [`ml cv`](#ml-cv) | Purged k-fold cross-validation of tabular models |
| [`ml walk-forward`](#ml-walk-forward) | Walk-forward evaluation of tabular models |
| [`ml cpcv-pbo`](#ml-cpcv-pbo) | CPCV backtest paths and PBO overfitting gate |
| [`ml version`](#ml-version) | Show version information. |

## `ml run`

Run the full pipeline (features, labels, training, ensemble, deploy)

```text
python -m src.cli run [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-path`, `-d` | PATH |  | Raw OHLCV file (parquet or csv) |
| `--symbol`, `-s` | TEXT | `MES` | Trading symbol |
| `--horizons`, `-h` | TEXT | `20` | Label horizons (comma-separated) |
| `--models`, `-m` | TEXT | `xgboost` | Models to train (comma-separated; see `ml models`) |
| `--training-mode` | TEXT | `standard` | Training mode: standard, walk_forward, regime_aware, meta_labeling |
| `--build-ensemble` | flag | off | Stack the base models into an ensemble |
| `--meta-learner` | TEXT | `ridge_meta` | Stacking meta-learner: ridge_meta, xgboost_meta, mlp_meta, calibrated_meta, voting_meta |
| `--bar-timeframe` | TEXT |  | Resample input bars before training, e.g. 5min |
| `--mtf`, `--no-mtf` | flag | `--mtf` | Multi-timeframe features (shift(1) anti-lookahead) |
| `--n-splits` | INT |  | Purged CV folds (default 5) |
| `--purge-bars` | INT |  | CV purge gap in bars (default: longest label span, max_bars over horizons; smaller values are raised to it) |
| `--embargo-bars` | INT |  | CV embargo gap in bars (default: one trading day at the bar timeframe, capped at 25% of a CV fold) |
| `--n-trials` | INT | `0` | Optuna hyperparameter trials per model (0 = no tuning) |
| `--max-epochs` | INT |  | Neural max epochs |
| `--batch-size` | INT |  | Neural batch size |
| `--backtest`, `--no-backtest` | flag | `--no-backtest` | Backtest the predictions with barrier-aligned exits |
| `--deploy`, `--no-deploy` | flag | `--deploy` | Write the bundle and deploy artifact |
| `--seed` | INT | `42` | Random seed of the run (models, Optuna, feature selection) |
| `--tracking` | TEXT | `none` | Experiment tracking: none, local (JSON under <output-dir>/tracking) or mlflow (pip install '.[mlflow]') |
| `--tracking-uri` | TEXT |  | Tracking directory (local) or MLflow tracking URI |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | PATH | `experiments` | Output root; the run writes <dir>/<run_id>/ |
| `--config`, `-c` | PATH |  | ExperimentConfig YAML (replaces the options above) |
| `--resume` | PATH |  | Run directory to resume from its last checkpoint (settings come from the run's experiment_config.yaml) |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | off | Debug logging |

## `ml data`


| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `--symbol`, `-s` | TEXT | `MES` | Trading symbol |

| `--mtf`, `--no-mtf` | flag | `--mtf` | Multi-timeframe features |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | PATH | `experiments` | Output root; writes <dir>/<run_id>/ |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | off | Debug logging |

## `ml status`

Show checkpoint progress of a run

```text
python -m src.cli status [OPTIONS] {run_dir}
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | PATH, required | Run directory (<output_dir>/<run_id>) |

## `ml models`

List registered models or show one model's configuration

```text
python -m src.cli models [OPTIONS] [model]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MODEL` | TEXT, optional | Model name for its default configuration; omit to list all models |

## `ml cv`

Purged k-fold cross-validation of tabular models

```text
python -m src.cli cv [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-path`, `-d` | PATH | required | Raw OHLCV file (parquet or csv) |
| `--models`, `-m` | TEXT | required | Comma-separated models or 'all' |
| `--symbol`, `-s` | TEXT | `MES` | Trading symbol |
| `--horizons`, `-h` | TEXT | `5,10,15,20` | Comma-separated horizons or 'all' |
| `--bar-timeframe` | TEXT |  | Resample input bars first, e.g. 5min |
| `--mtf`, `--no-mtf` | flag | `--mtf` | Multi-timeframe features |
| `--n-splits` | INT | `5` | Number of CV folds |
| `--purge-bars` | INT |  | Purge bars before each test fold (default: label span) |
| `--embargo-bars` | INT |  | Embargo bars after each test fold (default: one day) |
| `--no-feature-selection` | flag | off | Disable per-fold feature selection |
| `--n-features` | INT | `50` | Number of features to select per fold |
| `--tune` | flag | off | Enable Optuna hyperparameter tuning |
| `--n-trials` | INT | `50` | Number of Optuna trials per model |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | PATH | `experiments` | Output root; writes <dir>/<run_id>/cv/ |
| `--seed` | INT | `42` | Random seed (models, Optuna, feature selection) |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | off | Enable verbose logging |

## `ml walk-forward`

Walk-forward evaluation of tabular models

```text
python -m src.cli walk-forward [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-path`, `-d` | PATH | required | Raw OHLCV file (parquet or csv) |
| `--models`, `-m` | TEXT | required | Comma-separated models or 'all' |
| `--symbol`, `-s` | TEXT | `MES` | Trading symbol |
| `--horizons`, `-h` | TEXT | `5,10,15,20` | Comma-separated horizons or 'all' |
| `--bar-timeframe` | TEXT |  | Resample input bars first, e.g. 5min |
| `--mtf`, `--no-mtf` | flag | `--mtf` | Multi-timeframe features |
| `--n-windows` | INT | `5` | Number of walk-forward windows |
| `--window-type` | TEXT | `expanding` | Window type: expanding or rolling |
| `--min-train-pct` | FLOAT | `0.4` | Minimum training data percentage |
| `--test-pct` | FLOAT | `0.1` | Test window percentage |
| `--gap-bars` | INT |  | Gap bars between train and test (default: label span) |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | PATH | `experiments` | Output root; writes <dir>/<run_id>/walk-forward/ |
| `--seed` | INT | `42` | Random seed (models, Optuna, feature selection) |

## `ml cpcv-pbo`

CPCV backtest paths and PBO overfitting gate

```text
python -m src.cli cpcv-pbo [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--data-path`, `-d` | PATH | required | Raw OHLCV file (parquet or csv) |
| `--models`, `-m` | TEXT | required | Comma-separated models or 'all' |
| `--symbol`, `-s` | TEXT | `MES` | Trading symbol |
| `--horizons`, `-h` | TEXT | `20` | Comma-separated horizons |
| `--bar-timeframe` | TEXT |  | Resample input bars first, e.g. 5min |
| `--mtf`, `--no-mtf` | flag | `--mtf` | Multi-timeframe features |
| `--n-groups` | INT | `6` | Number of time groups |
| `--n-test-groups` | INT | `2` | Groups held out as test |
| `--purge-bars` | INT |  | Bars purged around each test group (default: label span) |
| `--embargo-bars` | INT |  | Bars embargoed after each test group (default: one day) |
| `--n-partitions` | INT | `16` | CSCV row blocks S for PBO (even) |
| `--pbo-warn` | FLOAT | `0.5` | PBO warning threshold |
| `--pbo-block` | FLOAT | `0.8` | PBO blocking threshold |
| `--no-costs` | flag | off | Compute strategy returns without transaction costs |
| `--output-dir`, `-o` | PATH | `experiments` | Output root; writes <dir>/<run_id>/cpcv-pbo/ |
| `--seed` | INT | `42` | Random seed (models, Optuna, feature selection) |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag | off | Enable verbose logging |
